faqs.question: Can I rely on this Ciprofloxacin information instead of a doctor visit?
faqs.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faqs.question: Can I adjust the dose of Ciprofloxacin on my own?
faqs.answer: Dose changes should only be made with clinician guidance. Self-adjustment can increase side effects or reduce effectiveness.
